source_identity_algorithm: SHA-256 of sorted UTF-8 relative path + NUL + raw SHA-256(file bytes), over tracked and non-ignored untracked source. docs/evidence/, plans/progress.json, docs/agents/SESSION_HANDOFF.json and SHA256SUMS.txt excluded; each command records identity at start.
scope: F10 internal collector batch delivery: exact C04 bytes, whole-batch validation, durable append-only spool.ack records through C05, lost-ACK replay without duplicate observations, and capacity counting only unacknowledged events. No transport, public HTTP endpoint, CLI, UI or authentication claim.
owner_scope_resolution: The C16 card targets internal/collector/ingest.go and tests/replay_test.go. The pre-existing C05 spool had gap records but no acknowledgement record, so this slice also adds the canonical spool.ack record, ACK-aware sequence/capacity checks and storage decoding. The C04 event schema and version 1 C05 manifest are unchanged. Review follow-up: the misleading Replayed field was removed because a first delivery from the durable spool already has event records; Acknowledgement now reports only batch metadata and per-event event/ACK receipts. C16 creates no incident record; C19/C20 consume this duplicate-free event observation path. C16 is an internal Go boundary; it does not implement C09 mTLS, a network listener, an authenticated ingest endpoint or HTTP/UI/CLI behavior. The C09 planning card mentioned a future ingest endpoint, but the C16 exact targets add none; that forward-looking claim is not asserted here and the C09 card/IDENTITY wording was corrected. The collector accepts no filesystem path: a traversal-looking or symlink metadata.path is inert C04 observation data and is never resolved or opened, so there is no path input to reject. Event identity (sensor_id, sequence, exact bytes) is the dedup key; batch_id is correlation metadata.

fixtures.provenance: Repository-authored synthetic C16 batches and expected outcomes; ephemeral in-memory test keys; no real traffic or credentials.

results.positive: The fixture-backed two-event batch is accepted, its exact events are stored and one durable spool.ack per event is appended; success returns only after the ACK manifest publication. Reopening the real C05 store preserves both events and both ACKs. The second batch and a single remaining event are accepted with capacity reclaimed by unacknowledged-only counting.
results.negative: Empty/missing/oversized/invalid/unsupported/zero-sequence/out-of-order/sensor-mismatched/conflicting batches fail with typed errors and leave the store unchanged. Forged, orphaned, duplicate and future ACKs fail sequence/history validation and reclaim no capacity. A cancelled context and missing applied configuration fail explicitly.
results.restart: Real child-process SIGKILL at four acknowledgement boundaries and nine injected publication failures leave either the event-only prefix or event-plus-ACK prefix; reopening and exact retry converge to one event and one ACK per sequence. These are local process-crash and injected-filesystem-error proofs, not physical power-loss proof.
results.discovery: Four engine suites and 92 required anchors executed and accepted by the discovery guard.
results.network: All TestCollector tests passed under strace with zero network syscalls; the package import allowlist excludes net, net/http, os, os/exec, path/filepath and syscall.
results.workflow: Local browser, package checksum, repository contract, Python integrity and clean-clone equivalents are recorded below; no GitHub-hosted run or publication occurred.

security_review: C04 validation and C07 sequence/event identity are checked before the first visible collector write; the whole batch is pre-validated.
ACKs are append-only and reference an existing exact event digest; they never delete or rewrite event bytes and cannot acknowledge a gap.
C05 operation, byte and manifest quotas bound ACK growth; quota errors are explicit. A forged or orphaned ACK fails closed.
The collector accepts no path, opens no file and imports no network, OS-process, path or syscall package; hostile metadata.path remains inert.
C16 adds no database schema, migration, environment file, Dockerfile, dependency, listener, public endpoint, CLI or UI surface.
limits: Only local process-crash/injected-error recovery is proven; physical power loss and remote-runner/GitHub Actions behavior are not certified.
No transport, mTLS terminator, authenticated ingest endpoint, HTTP/CLI/UI surface or real sensor identity is added or claimed.
C28 resource capacity is unmeasured; C30 remains the full clean-host workflow/restart/restore gate.
C17/C18 segmentation/indexing must skip spool.gap and spool.ack as events, and C23 retention must not orphan an ACK or delete an event while its ACK remains.
Browser regression ran on 127.0.0.1:4174 with a temporary Playwright config because another user process occupied the canonical 4173 port; the same three browser tests passed.
rollback: Keep event bytes and ACK records together. Never restore an older manifest to erase accepted data or ACKs. A C16-compatible reader is required after the first spool.ack record is written.
